field.name: telegram_bot_token
field.placeholder: Paste the bot token; saving verifies the bot

field.name: telegram_webhook_secret
field.placeholder: Generate automatically for a new connection

xpath.div: Saving a new token verifies the bot with Telegram and securely stores its credentials. The database is selected automatically. Leave the webhook secret blank to generate one for a new connection, or keep the existing secret when replacing a token. To set your own, use 32–256 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens. Existing credentials are never shown in these inputs. Verification does not enable delivery.

xpath.attribute: Telegram’s numeric bot ID, filled automatically after token verification. It is not the bot username or a recipient chat ID.
Telegram uses the bot ID as its account scope. The system fills this automatically.

group.div: Private text only. Test with up to ten consenting private users. Example recipient ID: 123456789. Your deployment administrator obtains these numeric user/chat IDs from verified Telegram updates. Authorizing the sandbox verifies the bot and permits processing for this test list; you must still configure receiving rules, recipient permission and message approval.

button.name: action_authorize_telegram_sandbox
button.confirm: Verify this bot and authorize sandbox processing for the displayed recipient IDs and evidence? Each reply still requires current consent and separate approval.

button.name: action_revoke_telegram_sandbox
button.confirm: Stop sandbox intake and future send claims? Existing in-flight sends may still complete; unclaimed work will require fresh approval.

button.name: action_enable_telegram_dispatch
button.confirm: Enable new dispatch claims for human-approved private replies to this bot's authorized sandbox recipients? The scheduler is configured separately. This does not send a message now.

xpath.p: Telegram sandbox replies require explicit account authorization, a verified private conversation, current recipient consent and separate message approval. Pausing stops new claims; in-flight sends may finish.
Provider dispatch requires a verified adapter and explicit activation. Pausing stops new claims; in-flight sends may finish.

form.p: Copy this secret into the Telegram webhook registration. Keep it private. This does not register or enable a webhook.
